home.title: Pano
home.tagline: Feedback boards and a public roadmap.

signin.title: Sign in to Pano
signin.emailIntro: Enter your email and we'll send you a 6-digit code. New here? The same code creates your account.
signin.sendFailed: We couldn't send a code. Try again in a moment.
signin.tooManyCodes: Too many codes requested. Wait a minute and try again.
signin.codeSentTo: We sent a code to {email}. It expires in 5 minutes.
signin.codeInvalid: That code didn't work. Check it, or request a new one.
signin.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then request a new code.

newWorkspace.title: Create your workspace
newWorkspace.intro: A workspace holds your boards and roadmap. You can rename it later; the address stays.
newWorkspace.localeHint: Visitors see this language unless they pick another.

workspace.notFound: There's no workspace at this address.

post.notFound: This request doesn't exist or was deleted.

settings.boardsHint: Boards group requests, for example features and bugs.

errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
